title: A Closed-Loop Control Architecture for Reliable Constraint Satisfaction in LLM Text Generation
abstract: arXiv:2609.19710v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Software systems increasingly embed a large language model in features that must satisfy a numeric output constraint, that is, a requirement expressible as a number or an interval and checkable by code, such as a target word count or a target readability grade band. Because such a model is non-deterministic, is configured through natural-language instructions rather than a typed interface, and satisfies a stated requirement only approximately, a single prompt neither reliably meets the target nor preserves the source content. This paper presents and evaluates a closed-loop control architecture for this problem. It has five stages: generate, evaluate, adjust, archive, and analyze. The model is called only to write and to edit text, while deterministic code compares a composite readability value against a target band, rejects any edit that drops source entities, numbers, or keywords, and makes every accept decision. translated_title: 大语言模型文本生成中可靠约束满足的闭环控制架构
translated_abstract: arXiv:2609.19710v1 公告类型： new 摘要：软件系统日益将大语言模型嵌入到必须满足数值输出约束的功能中，即一种可表示为数字或区间、并可通过代码检验的要求，例如目标字数或目标可读性等级区间。由于此类模型是非确定性的，通过自然语言指令而非类型化接口进行配置，并且只能近似地满足所陈述的要求，因此单一提示词既不能可靠地达到目标，也不能保留源内容。本文提出并评估了一种针对该问题的闭环控制架构，包含五个阶段：生成、评估、调整、存档和分析。模型仅被调用以撰写和编辑文本，而确定性代码负责将综合可读性值与目标区间进行比较，拒绝任何丢失源实体、数字或关键词的编辑，并做出每一次接受决策。在超过114个单次……（摘要截断）
tldr: 本文提出一种五阶段闭环控制架构，让确定性代码负责约束评估与接受决策、大语言模型仅负责撰写与编辑文本，从而可靠地满足数值输出约束并保留源内容。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a five-stage closed-loop control architecture in which deterministic code performs constraint evaluation and acceptance decisions while the LLM is only invoked to write and edit text, enabling reliable satisfaction of numeric output constraints and preservation of source content.
